# Raindrop Marketing

> Raindrop Marketing builds AI-powered growth systems that get businesses found on Google and in AI search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), capture every lead, follow up automatically, and book them onto the calendar.

## Products
- [AI SEO](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/ai-seo): AI search optimization, ChatGPT / Gemini / Perplexity visibility, schema and entity optimization.
- [SEO & Local SEO](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/local-seo): Google Business Profile optimization, citations, keyword-optimized service pages, map pack rankings.
- [Content Creation](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/content-creation): Monthly SEO blogs, newsletters, content strategy and existing page optimization.
- [Functional Website](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/functional-website): Fast, mobile-first websites with lead capture, chat and on-page SEO.
- [Paid Ads](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/paid-ads): Google and Meta campaigns tracked to booked calls.
- [All-in-One Inbox](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/all-in-one-inbox): SMS, email, web chat, Facebook and Instagram in one inbox.
- [Missed Call Text Back](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/missed-call-text-back): Automatic text reply to every missed call.
- [One Click Marketing](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/one-click-marketing): Email and SMS campaigns to past customers.
- [5 Star Review System](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/products/review-system): Automated Google review requests.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://www.raindropmarketing.ca/pricing): Lead & Review System $297/mo (AI chat, missed call text back, follow-ups, inbox, automated review and referral requests); Basic Website $300-$500 one-time; AI SEO + Content packages (Growth $2,497/mo, Authority $3,497/mo, each plus $1,000 setup); custom websites, paid ads, marketing campaigns and content creation quoted individually.
